warnings.description: ASM-7 validation method is listed as 'Survey + interview.' This is acceptable but the AR does not specify minimum sample size for either method. Experiment design should address this gap.

ASM-12 (low-risk) has no validation plan entry, which is permitted by the spec. However, if experiments reveal this assumption is incorrect, it may require re-entry. The team should track this assumption even if not actively validating it.
